characters.name: Blooter
characters.description: A blue tall anthropomorphic dog who come up with ideas to solve problems. Accessory-Wearing Cartoon Animal: He sports a yellow helmet when riding his scooter, a red collar around his neck, and a yellow backpack on his back. Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: A blue tall dog with dark blue polka-dots. Amusing Injuries: In the episode "Blooter Gets a Boo-Boo", he is shown to be a little careless, as he accidentally banged his thumb when he tried to hammer the nails in. Author Avatar: Blooter is obviously based of the creator of the series, Jun Ichihara.

characters.name: Patty
characters.description: A bright yellow short anthropomorphic cat girl who knows everything. Blue Is Heroic: Wears a blue bandana around her neck. Catchphrase: "Fascinating!". Cats Hate Water: Most cats hate water, but Patty doesn't seem to mind the water. She loves playing in the rain and swimming in Sparkly Bay. Child-Like Voice: Patty has a cheery, high-pitched voice and acts like a cheerful cat girl.

characters.name: Bobby
characters.description: An orange anthropomorphic bear who helps with the equipment. Blue Is Heroic: Wears a blue beret on his head. Catchphrase: "Never fear, Bobb. E. Quipment is here!" and "I've got just the thing!". Code Name: Bobby is revealed to have a spy codename called "Nail-Hammer" in the episode "Eye Spy". Face Your Fears: He is shown to have a fear of volcanoes in the episode "Lava Luau".

characters.name: Alli
characters.description: An anthropomorphic jazzy alligator who has a big interest in music.

characters.name: Cocori
characters.description: An anthropomorphic chicken girl who loves making smoothies. Accessory-Wearing Cartoon Animal: She sports a red helmet and roller skate shoes when she skating around. Blue Is Heroic: Wears a blue scarf around her neck. Catchphrase: Her catchphrase is "chicken barks", when she talks. Country Cousin: Cocori is revealed to have a cousin named "Jeejeeri" in the episode "Chicken Flap".

characters.name: Cozy
characters.description: An anthropomorphic zebra who look after traffic. Accessory-Wearing Cartoon Animal: He sports a red helmet when riding his blue wooden horse. Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: A zebra with red and white stripes.

characters.name: Captain Cap
characters.description: A pink anthropomorphic sheep who loves to tell his pirate stories. Alliterative Name:CaptainCap. Blue Is Heroic: Wears a blue scarf around his neck. Byronic Hero: During his younger days, he found a mysterious pink wishing pearl before being a pirate. This was shown in the episode "Patty the Fairy". Cool Old Guy: The oldest and wisest of the Poppets, and he also wears a cool pirate costume.

characters.name: The Naka-Nakas (Robin, Jojo and Nicky)
characters.description: A trio of anthropomorphic monkey brothers who likes to cause trouble. Alliterative Name:Naka-Nakas. Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: A trio of purple monkeys. Big Eater: Best shown when they are eating a healthy meal in the episode "Doozy Dilemma". Character Focus: They've got too much focus in early episodes.
